author: Myv
body:
Hi everyone, _Za here.

I have been inactive recently, but I'm now back with a suggestion.

The summer holidays are nigh, and many people will choose to play Avicus.

So, I thought it would be nice to celebrate the summer holidays by having a whole week of Triple XP.

Due to the different break up times around the world, I think this should be held on the first Monday of August until the Sunday.

Opinions on this?
